name: Crown Works Kyojitsu Gairon 3 Shou
original_name: クラウンワークス虚実概論3章
source:
A novel game only for ones with traumatized hearts. 
The weapon is the authentic neuroscience and the description of imaginary magic spells.

By no means can damaged hearts be repaired.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE226706.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款只献给内心受过创伤之人的小说游戏。

武器是真实的神经科学，以及对虚构魔法咒语的描述。

受损的心灵绝不可能修复。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE226706.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
